4ab62aaea8a2f9104400e3467cf0f7731bbe2475.summary: Report on North Korea-backed Lazarus Group targeting job seekers with a macOS malware sample disguised as a Coinbase job-description PDF, with a Windows variant. ESET linked the Operation In(ter)ception campaign to the group, which the report places under the broader Operation Dream Job. The report also says the group has used several ransomware families (BEAF, PXJ, ZZZZ, CHiCHi, VHD, Maui, H0lyGh0st) and was sanctioned by the US in 2019.

4a50222f670f781ca703820d626b3a3bc659eb97.summary: Dell SecureWorks researchers reported a newly detected hacking group, Threat Group 3390, nicknamed Emissary Panda, believed to be based in China. It used watering hole attacks launched from over 100 compromised legitimate websites to steal industrial data from at least 50 organizations in the US and the United Kingdom, mainly in the automotive, electronic, aerospace, energy and pharmaceutical industries. It relied on old vulnerabilities, including CVE-2011-3544 and CVE-2010-0738, and used the PlugX remote access tool along with its own tools with Simplified Chinese interfaces.
